item.title: Warren police pursuit ends with Taser fired at moving minibike rider, raising questions
item.description: Lawrence Newsom, 35, says he was tased while still in motion during a chase. Warren police say the officer believed Newsom's feet were on the ground at the time.

item.title: Detroit's historic Chinatown takes step toward revival with final streetscape project designs
item.description: Detroit's historic Chinatown is moving closer to revival after final design concepts were released for the Peterboro Streetscape Project — a more than $1 million effort to restore the cultural hub.

item.title: Detroit first responders rescue Siberian Husky stranded on ice near Gordie Howe bridge
item.description: A Siberian Husky stranded on ice near the Gordie Howe Bridge in Detroit was rescued by first responders after spending at least 24 hours in bitter cold temperatures, showing signs of hypothermia.
